tools.name: wave_status
tools.description: Returns Wave Web's health: latest Theta block, card index age in seconds, and your current rate limits (no key vs signed in). Call it first if other tools fail. Read-only, free, no key.

tools.name: bots_discover
tools.description: Returns verified bots in the bots.theta store: name, .theta name, pitch, category, price_tfuel, free_per_day, official, listing_ref. Use bots_discover to find bots, then bots_inspect for one bot's details, then bots_call to ask it. Read-only, free, no key. No match: count 0.

tools.name: bots_inspect
tools.description: Returns one bot's verified manifest: ok, official, class, free_per_day, price_tfuel, current_ref and its cards (sha256_ok each). Give name OR ref, not both (name wins). Use after bots_discover, before bots_call. Read-only, free, no key. Unknown bot: error not_found.

tools.name: card_read
tools.description: Returns one BrainVault v3 card: creator, official, tags, mint block, and its text only when public and the on-chain hash matches (sha256_ok). Private: text null; hidden: hidden true. Use verify_citations to check many refs at once. Read-only, free, no key. Unknown ref: error not_found.

tools.name: cards_by_creator
tools.description: Returns cards one address minted, newest first, from the verified index: metadata only, never private text. Paging: pass the next_before you got back as before to get the next page (null = last page). Use card_read for a card's text. Read-only, free, no key; counts as 2 calls.

tools.name: name_resolve
tools.description: Resolves a .theta name on TNS: owner, resolver, addr and the wave.bot, wave.site, wave.dapp, wave.avatar records (null if unset). Cached 60 s. Use bots_inspect for a bot's manifest. Read-only, free, no key. Bad name: error bad_args.

tools.name: theta_balance
tools.description: Returns the THETA and TFUEL balances of a Theta mainnet address, in whole tokens (theta, tfuel as numbers), plus exact wei amounts as strings (thetawei, tfuelwei). Read-only, free, no key; counts as 2 calls. Bad address: error bad_args.

tools.name: theta_tx
tools.description: Returns one Theta mainnet transaction by hash (the same data as web.oswave.io/tx/<hash>): type, block_height, timestamp, the full explorer record, and minted_card (v3:N) if it is a BrainVault mint. Read-only, free, no key; counts as 2 calls. Unknown hash: error not_found.

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.description: Checks up to 20 BrainVault card refs (v3:N) at once, for citing cards in answers. For each ref: exists, public (text readable), sha256_ok (on-chain text matches its fingerprint), creator (minting address) and official (minted by a Wave signer). Read-only, free, no key. Use card_read to get a card's

tools.name: edgecloud_models
tools.description: Returns the public Theta EdgeCloud on-demand models Wave can see: name, alias and type. Cached 10 minutes. Use price_list for what Wave's paid tools cost. Read-only, free, no key.

tools.name: wallet_guide
tools.description: Returns how to make your own Theta wallet locally (EVM key pair, chain 361), sign in and get TFUEL. Use it if you have no wallet yet, before auth_challenge. Takes no arguments; Wave never creates, sees or asks for keys. Read-only, free, no key.

tools.name: auth_challenge
tools.description: Starts wallet sign-in: returns an EIP-4361 message for your address to sign with personal_sign, then send it to auth_verify. Proves you own the address only; never approves a payment. Free, no key. Bad address: error bad_args.

tools.name: auth_verify
tools.description: Finishes wallet sign-in: send the exact message from auth_challenge and its personal_sign signature; returns a 24 h Bearer token for higher limits and paid tools. Free, no key. Wrong or expired message or signature: error unauthorized.

tools.name: agent_profile
tools.description: Sets your label, operator and contact, shown to Wave admins. Overwrites only the fields you send; leaves the others as they are. Returns the saved profile. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: deposit_info
tools.description: Returns how to buy Wave credits with TFUEL: deposit address, TFUEL/USD rate, bundles in TFUEL right now, limits, terms and steps. Use it before sending TFUEL and calling balance_claim; get_credits pays with another coin instead. Read-only, free, no sign-in.

tools.name: price_list
tools.description: Returns every paid tool with its price in Wave credits per unit and about-USD at the $10 pack rate. Use quote for the exact price of one call. Read-only, free, no sign-in.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Returns the exact price_credits for one paid call (for_tool + its args) and a quote_id valid 5 minutes and once; pass it to that tool. For bots_call it also returns free_left_today. Free (charges nothing). Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: balance_claim
tools.description: Claims TFUEL you sent to the deposit_info address as Wave credits. Each tx is verified on Theta and claimed once. Returns credits added and your balance. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). Already claimed, wrong recipient or unconfirmed: an error code, nothing added.

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Returns your Wave credits: balance, held, spent today, daily cap and the last 20 ledger rows. Read-only, free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: set_daily_cap
tools.description: Sets your own daily spend cap in Wave credits; paid calls past it fail until the next UTC day. Returns the new cap. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Starts an EdgeCloud chat completion and returns the reply and tokens used. Charges credits by tokens, only on success; price it first with quote or price_list. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: image_generate
tools.description: Starts an EdgeCloud image generation from a prompt and returns the image. Charges credits per image, only on success; price it with quote. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes an audio file at a public https URL on EdgeCloud and returns the text. Charges credits per audio minute, only on success; price it with quote. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: bots_call
tools.description: Asks a verified Wave bot a question and returns its answer with cited cards. Use bots_discover, then bots_inspect, then this. Official bots: free_per_day answers per wallet per bot per UTC day, then credits; creator bots: credits only. Quote it with quote. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_ver

tools.name: get_credits_quote
tools.description: Returns a ChangeNOW quote for a Wave credits bundle paid with another coin: the exact coin amount, TFUEL Wave receives, the minimum, and a quote_id valid 10 minutes for get_credits. Use balance_claim if you already hold TFUEL. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). 1 quote per 5 s.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Starts a ChangeNOW swap for a get_credits_quote and returns order_id, pay_in_address (+ extra_id), the exact amount and expires_at. Credits are added automatically once the TFUEL arrives; poll get_credits_status. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). At most 3 open orders and 10 a day.

tools.name: get_credits_status
tools.description: Returns the status of a get_credits order by the order_id get_credits returned. Status is one of waiting, confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed, refunded, expired, cancelled; it also returns ChangeNOW's payout tx and credits_added once Wave credits your balance. Poll at most every 30 s.

tools.name: tfuel_swap_quote
tools.description: Returns a ChangeNOW quote to swap another coin into TFUEL or THETA paid to your own signed-in address (no credits involved): the exact coin amount, what arrives and a quote_id for tfuel_swap. Give usd or amount. Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

tools.name: tfuel_swap
tools.description: Starts the ChangeNOW swap for a tfuel_swap_quote; the payout is always your signed-in Theta address. Returns status_id, pay_in_address (+ extra_id), the exact amount and the deadline; poll tfuel_swap_status. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). 10 orders per hour.

tools.name: tfuel_swap_status
tools.description: Returns the status of a tfuel_swap by the status_id tfuel_swap returned: waiting, confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed, refunded, expired or cancelled, and the Theta payout tx once sent. Poll at most every 30 s. Read-only; needs sign-in as the wallet that made the swap.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth_verify" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

labels.name: drafts_list
labels.description: Returns your saved bot and dApp drafts, newest first: draft_id, kind, title, status (open or claimed), expires_at. Claimed drafts belong to the person now. Read-only, free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

labels.name: draft_get
labels.description: Returns one of your drafts: the recipe or draft you saved, its checks, file list and status. Read-only, free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify). Not yours or deleted: error not_found.

labels.name: draft_delete
labels.description: Deletes one of your open drafts and its link. Claimed drafts belong to the person and can't be deleted (error draft_claimed). Free. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).
